svg.text: Key: PK = primary key (unique row identifier) · FK = foreign key (links to another table) · ID = non-unique person identifier · lines join the exact columns used to relate tables; "1 : many" = one row on the 1-side matches many on the other.
Hub tables (dark headers): orders and order_items. Note: feedback_id can also span several orders, and order_items has 60 exact duplicate rows, so its intended key is not yet unique.
